HLLTOP
FREFGHT
THE KACHIN INDEPENDENCE ARMY HILLTOP WARFARE SIMULATOR

26 positions · 150–300 m apart · 90-second rounds · 60 bullets (2 magazines) per level · reach the kill target to take the next hill

  • Click shoot · Hold Alt aim down sights · ducked: click an item to use it
  • Scroll down duck · up stand (or Space)
  • Right-click / F RPG
  • R or shoot the target: reload · night: duck and click a flare

Duck at the scope glint, the RPG warning and the artillery whistle. Look for faces — some are decoy helmets on sticks (−50 if you shoot one). Shoot drones down. Burn their flag with an RPG for +500. At night some sneak down the hill — shoot them before they reach your trench. RPGs blow gaps in the dirt wall — hit a soldier passing the gap for +200 + extra RPG. See cigarette smoke? Someone is hiding — an RPG gets them.
